`abstract class Transition`<br/>
**Known subtypes:** [`PopTransition`](/reference/ui/poptransition/)<br/>
**Package:** `dev.joid.lib.ui.core.transition` · **Module:** `core` · **Source:** [Transition.java](https://github.com/Zeldown/JOID/blob/main/core/src/main/java/dev/joid/lib/ui/core/transition/Transition.java)

The pair of steps that a UI plays when it opens and when it closes.

## Description

Give one to a UI with [`UI.transition`](/reference/ui/ui/#UI-property-transition); a popup gets a [`PopTransition`](/reference/ui/poptransition/) from `@UIDataPopup`.
Write your own by extending this class and passing two [`TransitionStep`](/reference/ui/transitionstep/) to the constructor.
